title: skills: teach the six publish-time traps that #34776 turns into checks
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

PR #35244 (cards #34776 and #35146) adds six authoring rules. They run at the runtime publish gate and in the CLI, and their names are:

- `flow-node-type-no-executor`
- `flow-approval-decision-unrouted`
- `flow-http-timeout-missing` (warning)
- `field-boolean-required`
- `state-machine-no-initial-states`
- `action-no-object-binding`

#34776's Scope says that when a rule lands, the matching trap leaves the skills' prose, or is rewritten to point at the check. The rule becomes the check first and the prose second (ruling E1 = A, #34659 comment 6940528935).

## Scope

- In `skills/**`, find the text that teaches each of the six traps. The dev report on #34776 notes that no skill text teaches `field-boolean-required` today.
- Replace each trap warning with one line naming the publish-time finding and its fix, or drop it where the check makes it redundant.
- Regenerate any served skill file (`*.generated.ts`).
- This is a `domain:skills` PR, which is why it is not in the domain:devx/server PR #35244.

Blocked until #35244 merges.

## Origin

The `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #35244. The claim amendment is #34776 comment 6987471285.

Re-check: `git grep -n "initialStates\|timeoutMs\|NO_EXECUTOR\|approve.*reject" origin/main -- skills/`
